id: 第二章-善恶篇-奉教人之死-一-p1

en: 第二章-善恶篇-奉教人之死-一
Long ago, at St. Luke's Church in Nagasaki, Japan, there was a local boy named Lorren who, on Christmas Eve, fainted from extreme hunger at the church gate.
u.src: 以前，在日本长崎圣鲁卡教堂，有一个本地少年，名字叫罗连，在圣诞夜的时候饥饿过度，晕倒在教堂门口。

en: Fortunately, believers came to his aid, and through the priest's sympathy and pity, he was taken in and allowed to stay in the church.
u.src: 幸而得到奉教人施以援手，被收到神甫的同情怜悯，才被收留在教堂中。

en: Whenever he was asked about his background, he said that his home was in heaven and that his father was called the Lord.
u.src: 每次被问到身世，他都说自己的家在天国，自己的父亲名为天主。

en: Everyone could only laugh it off; in the end no one knew his true origins, only that he wore a blue-green jade rosary on his wrist and was not a pagan.
u.src: 众人都只能笑笑了之，终究没有人知道他的真实来历，只知道他的手腕上系着青玉念珠，知道他不是异教徒。

en: So, beginning with the priest, everyone in the church refrained from blaming him and instead cared for and supported him with great attention.
u.src: 于是以神甫为首，教堂里的众人都不曾责怪他，并且都悉心照顾扶持他。

en: The boy's faith in the Lord was so firm, unlike that of boys his age, that all the elders were deeply astonished,
u.src: 少年对主的信仰十分坚定，不像他这个年纪的少年，众长老都非常惊讶，

en: and they always felt that even if Lorren was not a heavenly child reborn, he was still a boy from a good family, so they all protected him with the utmost care.
u.src: 一直觉得罗连就算不是天通转世，也是良家少年，于是都对他呵护备至。

en: Loren was fair and refined, like polished jade; his voice was gentle and delicate like a woman's, and his nature was also very kind, so everyone loved him dearly.
u.src: 罗连面似冠玉般清秀，声音像女子般轻婉，性格也很温柔，因此深得大家的疼爱。

en: Among the believers was a local man named Simeon, who was as close to Loren as a brother,
u.src: 众教徒中有一个本地人，名叫西美昂，对罗连亲如手足，

en: and in their daily comings and goings they always went together, never leaving each other's side.
u.src: 平常出入都是携伴而行，形影不离。

en: Simeon came from a samurai family that had served a daimyo; he was powerfully built, strong, and imposing,
u.src: 西美昂出身于奉仕大名之武士家，身材魁梧有力，十分伟岸，

en: so whenever unbelievers harassed the church by throwing stones at it, the priest ordered him to step forward and defend it.
u.src: 每当教堂被异教徒投石滋扰，神甫都下令让他挺身防卫。

en: The depth of her affection and closeness with Loren was like a great eagle keeping company with a young dove,
u.src: 她与罗连相亲相爱的程度，就像雄鹰之伴乳鸽，

ja: かせるようなものだった。
en: or like a grapevine that can bloom with beautiful flowers only by climbing up a mountain cypress.
u.src: 亦如葡萄的藤攀爬在山桧木上才能绽放美丽的花朵。

en: Time slipped by, and in the blink of an eye three years had passed.
u.src: 时光荏苒，转瞬三载。

en: When Loren reached the age of about twenty, a strange rumor of intimacy suddenly began to spread: people said that the daughter of an umbrella shop not far from the church and Loren were confiding in each other.
u.src: 罗连到了弱冠的年纪，那个时候突然流传起奇怪的要好，说是在距离教堂不远处的坊间有一个伞铺的女儿和罗连互相倾诉。

en: The old man who owned that shop was also a Christian, and he often brought his daughter to the church for worship,
u.src: 这个铺子的老翁也是天主教徒，常常带着女儿来教堂礼拜，

en: and during prayers, his daughter would often cast flirtatious glances at Loren, who was serving with the censer.
u.src: 祷告的时候，他的女儿经常对职司提炉的罗连暗送秋波。

en: Moreover, every time this young woman went to the church, she was sure to dress herself up splendidly and stare at Loren,
u.src: 而且这个女子每次去教堂的时候，必定打扮的花枝招展，盯着罗连看，

en: which made all the believers look askance.
u.src: 此事让众教人纷纷侧目。

en: Some said they had seen this young woman deliberately step on Loren's foot as she walked,
u.src: 有人说看见此女子走路的时候，故意踩罗连的的脚，

en: and had also seen the two of them passing love letters and the like back and forth.
u.src: 并且看见两个人互相递送情书等。

en: After the priest learned of this matter, one day he called Lorenzo into his room and spoke to him gently:
u.src: 神甫知道这件事后，某一天，叫罗连到自己屋内，委婉的对他说：

en: There are rumors outside that you and the umbrella shop owner's daughter have behaved improperly. Is this true?
u.src: “外面有传言说你和伞铺的女儿行为不检，这件事是否属实？”

en: Lorenzo's face was clouded with sorrow; he shook his head again and again, and while sobbing, repeatedly insisted:
u.src: 罗连满脸愁云，连连摇头，一边哽咽，一边再三声称：
“绝不此事。”

en: The priest thought he was still young and had always been firm in his faith, and knowing that he would never lie, he believed him.
u.src: 神甫认为他年龄还小，平时信仰坚定，知道他绝对不会说谎，于是相信了他。

en: Although the priest's doubts had been cleared away, the rumors spreading among the believers showed no sign of diminishing,
u.src: 无奈神甫的疑虑虽然解除了，但是流传在众教人之间的留言并没有减少的迹象，

ja: シメオンとロレンソは
en: Since Simeon and Lorenzo were as close as brothers, he naturally took the matter even more to heart.
u.src: 西美昂和罗连情同手足，自然对这件事就更加介怀。

ja: ずかしくてたまらなかった。
en: When he first heard of this disgraceful affair, he himself felt unbearably ashamed,
u.src: 刚开始听到这个丑事的时候，自己都觉得羞愧难当，

ja: いただすつもりだった。
en: He had meant to question him sternly, but every time he saw Lorenzo's face, he found it hard to believe.
u.src: 本来想厉声询问，但是每次看到罗连的脸，就觉得难以置信。

en: One day, in the back garden of the Church of Saint Luke, he found a love letter that the woman had written to Lorenzo,
u.src: 有一天，在圣鲁卡教堂的后园里，见到了那个女子写给罗连的情书，

ja: なだめたりすかしたりして、
en: and when no one was in the house, he threw it down before Lorenzo and questioned him again and again, coaxing and pressing him by turns,
u.src: 趁着屋里没人，把情书扔到了罗连面前，连哄带诱，再次反复询问，

en: Lorenzo flushed red in the face and ears and answered sharply, "This woman may have feelings for me,
u.src: 罗连面红耳赤，厉声回答：“这个女子虽然对我有心，

en: but I only received her letters and have never once answered her."
u.src: 但是我只是收了情书，但是从未答复过她。”

en: But Simeon still did not believe him and kept pressing him with repeated questions,
u.src: 但是西美昂仍然不相信，一直反复追问，

en: Lorenzo said angrily, "Do you think I am the sort of man who would deceive God?"
u.src: 罗连生气的说：“你以为我是会欺骗上帝的人吗？”

en: With that, he left in anger, like a startled bird.
u.src: 说完，愤而离去，就像受惊了鸟儿一般。

en: Simeon deeply regretted his own suspiciousness and, dejected, was about to go out,
u.src: 西美昂非常后悔自己的多疑，沮丧的想要出去，

ja: いよくシメオンのほうへ
en: when he suddenly saw Lorenzo hurry back and fling himself straight toward Simeon,
u.src: 忽然看见罗连匆忙的折返回来，并一头扑进了西美昂的，

en: clutched him around the waist, and gasped, "It is my fault!"
u.src: 搂住他的腰，气喘吁吁的地生活：“是我不好！”

en: Before Simeon could even answer, Lorenzo had already covered his tearful face and quickly run off again.
u.src: 西美昂还没来记得回答，罗连已经捂着流泪的脸，又快速的跑了。

en: As for the whispered words "It is my fault," no one ever knew exactly what they meant: whether he was admitting that he had been involved with the woman and knew his own guilt,
u.src: 而“是我不好”的低语，终究不知道具体是什么意思，到底是承认自己和女子有染，自知有罪呢，

en: or whether he was deeply apologizing because he had spoken harshly to Simeon.
u.src: 还是因为自己对西美昂语气不好，而深表抱歉呢？

en: Before long, another rumor spread that the umbrella maker's daughter was pregnant, and that she had told her father the child in her womb was Lorren's.
u.src: 此后没多久，又有传言说伞铺的女儿身怀六甲，而且告诉他的父亲说肚子里的胎儿是罗连的骨肉。

en: The old umbrella maker was furious and immediately went to the priest to make his complaint.
u.src: 伞翁十分愤怒，立刻到神甫面前申诉。

en: Once matters had gone this far, Lorren had no words with which to defend himself.
u.src: 事情发展到这个地步，罗连没有辩解的说辞。

en: That day, the priest gathered the believers to discuss the matter, and they unanimously decided to excommunicate Lorren.
u.src: 这一天，神甫召集众教人商议，一致决定将罗连破门处置。

en: If Lorren were excommunicated, it would mean being driven out of the church, leaving him with no way to make a living.
u.src: 罗连一旦被破门处置，就意味着要被赶出教堂，生计也就没着落了。

en: But if such a sinner were allowed to keep living in the church, it would damage the glory of God, and that could never be permitted.
u.src: 但是这样的罪人，如果留他继续住在教堂，则会损害上帝的荣光，肯定不行。

en: Even the believers who had usually been close to Lorren had no choice but to shut him outside the gate with tears in their eyes.
u.src: 平时和罗连亲密来往的法众，也不得不挥泪拒罗连于门外。

en: The one who felt the deepest pain over it was Simeon.
u.src: 其中最感到痛心的人，就是西美昂。

en: Simeon pitied Lorenzo for being driven out, but he was also angry that Lorenzo had deceived him.
u.src: 西美昂既同情罗连被驱逐，又生气他欺骗自己，

en: So when Lorenzo hurriedly left the church, Simeon waited for him at the entrance and struck him with his fist.
u.src: 于是在罗连仓皇离开教堂的时候，在门口等着他给了他一拳，

en: Lorenzo was hit hard and fell face down on the ground, then managed to get back to his feet by himself.
u.src: 罗连受到痛击扑倒在地，然后自己勉强站了起来，

en: With tears filling his eyes, he let out a long sigh and prayed, Lord!
u.src: 满目含泪，长叹一口气祷告：“主啊！

en: Please forgive Simeon; he acted this way only because he does not know the truth.
u.src: 恳请您饶恕西美昂，他不知道真相才会这样的。”

en: When Simeon heard these words, he was suddenly overcome with melancholy.
u.src: 西美昂听到这话顿感怅然，

en: He could only stand blankly at the entrance, swinging his fist at the empty air.
u.src: 只能呆呆的站在门口，对着空气挥舞自己的拳头。

en: Only after the brothers pleaded with him in every way did he lower his hand.
u.src: 众兄弟百般劝说，他才放下手，

en: But he remained silent the whole time, his face dark and gloomy.
u.src: 但一直沉默不语，脸色阴郁。

en: According to those who saw it there at the time, a storm was about to come.
u.src: 据当时在现场看见的人说，当时暴风快来了，

en: Lorenzo walked alone through the cold wind, his head bowed in dejection, toward the afterglow of sunset in the western sky over Nagasaki.
u.src: 罗连在寒风中垂头丧气，向着长崎西空夕阳残照中踽踽而行，

en: The boy's graceful figure looked somewhat desolate, as though he were standing amid flames.
u.src: 少年优雅的身影略显萧条，就像置身于火焰中一样。

en: After this, Loren changed from the former thurible-bearing boy of Saint Luke's Church into a poor little beggar sheltering in a remote rural place outside the city.
u.src: 在这之后，罗连从以前圣鲁卡堂提炉童子，变成了栖身于郊外偏僻田园中一个可怜的小乞丐。

en: In particular, because he was a Catholic whom the pagans had always despised,
u.src: 尤其他是原来异教人歧视的天主教徒，

ja: からかわれるだけでなく、
en: now when he walked through the streets, he was not only mocked and teased by children, but was often fiercely attacked with sticks and stones.
u.src: 现在走在街头，不仅会被儿童嘲笑戏谑，而且常常被棍棒石头大攻击。

en: Nor was that all; at one point he came down with a fever,
u.src: 不止如此，他一度患上热病，

en: and lay beside the road to Nagasaki for seven days and seven nights, groaning as though he were about to die.
u.src: 在长崎道旁趴了七天七夜，呻吟欲绝。

en: Thanks to God's mercy, he barely managed to stay alive,
u.src: 幸亏天主垂爱，苟延残喘，

en: and when he had no money or food, wild fruit from the mountains and fish from the shore could serve as a day's provisions.
u.src: 在没有钱和粮食的时候，山间的野果和海滨的鱼，也可以当一天的口粮。

en: Even so, Loren still did not forget the morning and evening prayers from his days at Saint Luke's Church,
u.src: 即使是这样，罗连仍然没有忘记圣鲁卡教堂时候的朝夕祷告，

en: and the rosary on his wrist still kept its blue-jade luster.
u.src: 他手腕上的念珠，也不改青玉的光泽。

en: Moreover, whenever the night was deep and all was quiet,
u.src: 而且每当夜深人静的识货，

en: he would quietly leave the secluded yard and walk through the thin, scattered moonlight,
u.src: 他都悄悄走出偏僻的院子，踏着稀稀疏疏的月色，

en: going alone to the front of Saint Luke's Church to pray, silently asking God for protection.
u.src: 一个人到圣鲁卡教堂门前祷告，默默祈祷天主保佑。

en: His former fellow parishioners had long since grown distant from Lian and avoided him at every turn.
u.src: 以前的同堂，如今早就疏远了罗连，避之不及。

en: Beginning with the priest, no one showed him any pity.
u.src: 以神甫为主，没人怜悯他。

en: They knew that this shameless boy, excommunicated from the church, still had the faith to pray in the church every night,
u.src: 知道这个被破门处置的无耻少年，还有每夜在教堂祷告的信心，

en: and although the Lord's mercy is boundless, they still felt that his conduct was improper, and Lian found this painfully hard to bear.
u.src: 虽然主的的慈安是无量的，但是仍然觉得他的行为不合适，罗连对此，深觉得痛苦难言。

en: Not long after Lorenzo was excommunicated, the umbrella seller's daughter gave birth to a son,
u.src: 伞铺女在罗连被破门后不久，就生下了一个儿子，

en: and though the old umbrella seller was greatly astonished, when he looked at his infant grandson's tender face,
u.src: 伞翁虽然很是惊诧，但是看幼孙稚嫩的面容，

ja: いたりあやしたりして
en: he was no longer angry, and so he raised the child together with his daughter, holding him, soothing him, and making him the joy of their life.
u.src: 也不再生气，于是和女儿一起抚养，抱着哄着，当成了生活的乐趣。

en: The strangest of all was Simeon, one of the faithful,
u.src: 最为奇怪的是法众西美昂，

en: a man strong enough to contend with demons, who, after hearing that the umbrella seller's daughter had borne a son,
u.src: 这么一个力敌恶魔的汉子，听说伞女生下儿子之后，

en: would often go to the old umbrella seller's house, hold the child in his great arms, and gaze at that familiar face,
u.src: 经常当伞翁家里，用巨臂抱着小孩，看着他熟悉的容颜，

ja: きそうになるのだった
en: his eyes brimming as though he were about to weep, because he had never forgotten his brother Lorenzo.
u.src: 泫然欲泣，这是因为他一直没有忘记兄弟罗连的缘故。

en: Ever since Lorenzo had been driven out of the church, the umbrella seller's daughter
u.src: 伞铺的女儿自从罗连被赶出教堂之后，

en: often wore a resentful expression and never once showed Simeon a kind face.
u.src: 常常面露怨恨之色，对于西美昂从来没有过好脸色。

en: There is a local saying, “time flies like an arrow,” and in the blink of an eye another year had passed.
u.src: 本地有一个俗语说：“光阴似箭”，一晃又过去一年。

en: One day, a great fire suddenly struck the place, and Nagasaki was reduced to scorched earth overnight.
u.src: 某一天，此地突然遭逢大火，长崎市一夜之间化为焦土。

en: The sight was unspeakably horrific, as if one were hearing the final trumpet of judgment,
u.src: 景象无比惨烈，就像听到裁判最后的号角，

en: its sound breaking through the flames and ringing across the sky, terrifying all who heard it.
u.src: 声音冲破烈火，响彻天际，令人闻风丧胆。

en: At that time, San'onga happened to be on the downwind side,
u.src: 当时，伞翁加正当在下风扣，

en: and the parents had stumbled out of the house in panic, only to realize in the confusion that they could not find their little child,
u.src: 父母俩狼狈抛出屋外，仓皇间却忽然找不到幼儿，

en: who must have been left inside the house.
u.src: 应该是忘在屋里了。

en: San'onga immediately broke into loud sobs,
u.src: 伞翁顿时嚎啕，

en: and if the others had not held the woman back, she would have thrown herself into the fire.
u.src: 如果不是众人拦着女子，女子就奋身跑进火场了。

en: But the wind kept growing stronger, and the fire kept growing larger,
u.src: 但是风越来越大，火也越来越大，

en: while the roaring flames seemed ready to swallow the sky, the mountains, and the stars all together.
u.src: 烈焰轰鸣，好似连天山繁星一起吞没。

en: The many people trying to fight the fire fell into complete disorder,
u.src: 众多救火的人乱作一团，

en: and apart from restraining the nearly mad woman who wanted to rush into the flames, none of them could do anything.
u.src: 除了阻拦要进火场的近乎疯狂的女子，也都束手无策。

en: At that moment, one man pushed through the crowd and rushed to the scene,
u.src: 这个时候，有一个人，推开众人，冲到现场，
这个人就是西美昂。

en: This huge, powerfully built man who feared neither life nor death
u.src: 这个不畏生死的彪形大汉，

en: took a brief look at the situation and then charged into the fire,
u.src: 略微观察了下形势，便冲进火场，

en: but the flames grew fiercer and fiercer, and thick smoke billowed into his face,
u.src: 但是火势越来越猛烈，浓烟滚滚扑面，

en: so several times he plunged into the smoke and then retreated again.
u.src: 他数次冲进浓烟又退了回来。

en: At last he could only go before San'onga and the woman and say,
u.src: 于是只能走到伞翁和女子前面说：

en: “In this matter, we can only pray for the Lord’s will,
u.src: “这件事只能祈求主的安排，

en: for it is no longer something human strength can stop.”
u.src: 不是人力可以阻止的了。”

en: Just then, someone suddenly shouted from behind San'onga,
u.src: 这个时候伞翁身后忽然有人大喊：

en: “O Lord, I beg You for protection.”
u.src: “天主啊，祈求保护。”

en: The voice was very familiar, and when Simeon turned around, he saw
u.src: 声音很是熟悉，西美昂转身发现，

en: that it was none other than Loren.
u.src: 那不就是罗连嘛。

en: The firelight shone on his thin, delicate face,
u.src: 火光照着他清瘦的脸庞，

en: and the strong wind sent his shoulder-length black hair flying,
u.src: 大风使他的及肩黑发飞扬，

en: his features were clear and graceful, and one could recognize him at a glance,
u.src: 眉目清丽，一眼就能认出他来，

en: as Loren stood before the crowd like a beggar,
u.src: 罗连像乞丐一样，站在众人面前，

en: without blinking, staring with shining eyes at the house within the great fire.
u.src: 眼睛一眨不眨，目光炯炯的望着大火种的家宅。

en: Suddenly, a violent gust of wind swept in,
u.src: 忽然，一阵狂风袭来，
他一跃向前，

en: racing in through the gaps between pillars of fire, walls of fire, and beams of flame.
u.src: 在火柱、火壁、火梁的间隙疾奔而入。

en: Simeon was shocked and turned pale,
u.src: 西美昂大惊失色，

en: then looked anxiously up at the sky and repeatedly made the sign of the cross over his chest as he prayed,
u.src: 急切的望着天空频频在胸前划着十字祷告：
“主啊，请赐福。”

en: For reasons he could not understand,
u.src: 不知道为什么，

en: what appeared before his eyes at that moment was Loren, in the bitter cold wind, coming to Saint Luke’s Church,
u.src: 此时他眼前出现的竟然是罗连在瑟瑟寒风中来开圣鲁卡教堂的时候，

en: his figure from behind elegant yet desolate in the lingering glow of the sunset.
u.src: 夕阳余晖中他的背影优雅而萧条。

en: At that moment, the believers around him saw Luo Lian's fearless, heroic figure and at once forgot the shame of his excommunication.
u.src: 这个时候周围的教众，看着罗连一往无前的英雄身姿，也都顿时忘了他被破门的耻辱，

en: A roar of voices rose like thunder, and people said to one another, "The bond between father and child is human nature itself; in the end it cannot be erased.
u.src: 呼声雷动，交口议论：“父子亲情本是天性，终究是不能抹杀的。

ja: せなかったロレンソも、
en: Luo Lian, who had stayed away for so long out of shame, still threw himself into the sea of fire at last to save his own flesh and blood."
u.src: 因为愧疚很久不出现的罗连，最后还是为了拯救自己的骨肉，舍身进入火海了。”

en: The old umbrella man felt the same way; watching Luo Lian's figure disappear, he too could no longer keep silent and shouted aloud.
u.src: 伞翁也有同样的感受，看着罗连消失的身影，不在沉默不语，也大喊出声。

en: The umbrella girl knelt on the ground, covered her face with both hands, and prayed with all her heart without moving at all.
u.src: 伞女则跪在低上，双手捂着脸，一心祈祷，动也不动。

en: Tongues of flame danced in the air, while thick smoke billowed and rushed against their faces.
u.src: 空中火舌飞舞，浓烟滚滚，扑面而来。

ja: らないかのようだった。
en: The umbrella girl only bowed her head and prayed silently, as though she knew nothing of anything happening around her.
u.src: 伞女只是低头默默祈祷，好像不知道周围发生的任何事情。

en: At this moment, everyone was gathered around the great fire,
u.src: 这个时候，众人都围绕在大火旁边，

en: when suddenly they joyfully cheered in unison again,
u.src: 忽然又开心的齐声欢呼，

en: but Luolian's hair was tangled into a wild mass,
u.src: 只是罗连头发乱作一团，

en: and he held the infant in his arms,
u.src: 手里抱着幼儿，

en: like a god descending, he dashed out of the blaze with all his strength.
u.src: 犹如天神降临，从大火中奋身跑出。

en: Just then, a roof beam that had burned almost to ashes,
u.src: 这个时候一个燃烧殆尽的屋梁，
突然从空中掉过下来，

en: with a thunderous crash, sending sparks flying everywhere,
u.src: 声大如雷，火花四溅，

en: and in an instant, the place where Luolian had been standing
u.src: 顿时罗连所在的地方，

en: was nothing but a red pillar of flame like a coral tree.
u.src: 就只有像珊瑚树似的红光火柱了。

en: Beginning with Simeon, and including the old umbrella man, everyone present witnessed this terrible calamity,
u.src: 以西美昂为首，包括伞翁在内的，所有在场的人，目睹了如此大祸，

en: and not one of them failed to shudder; all were frightened out of their wits and turned pale.
u.src: 没有不觉得怵目惊心的，都吓得大惊失色。

en: Meanwhile the umbrella woman was wailing aloud when, as if struck by lightning, she suddenly sprang up from the ground,
u.src: 这中间伞女嚎啕大哭，突遭雷击，突然从地上跃起，

en: then collapsed helplessly to the ground again, just as the child, whose life or death was unknown, came rolling over from somewhere,
u.src: 然后又沮丧的扑倒在地，只看生死不明的幼儿从地方翻滚而来，

en: and the umbrella woman lifted the child up and clasped it tightly to her breast.
u.src: 伞女抱起来幼儿紧紧地搂在怀里。

en: The Lord's power is boundless, the Lord's wisdom is boundless, and gratitude to the Lord is beyond words.
u.src: 主的法力无边，主的智慧无边，对主的感谢之情难以言喻。

en: Under the burning beam, Lorenzo had used every ounce of strength to throw the child far to the umbrella woman's feet, and the child was miraculously unharmed.
u.src: 罗连在火梁下面，拼进全力，远远的抛出幼儿到伞女脚下，幼儿竟然安然无恙。

en: When the umbrella woman lay face down on the ground, shedding hot tears of joy, the old umbrella man beside her also raised both arms high and could not help praising the boundless mercy of the Heavenly Father.
u.src: 当伞女伏在地上，高兴的流出热泪的时候，她旁边的伞翁也高举双腕，不由得赞美天父大慈大悲。

en: At the same time, Simeon tried to save Loren from beneath the burning beam and ran over as if flying.
u.src: 与此同时，西美昂试图拯救火梁下面的罗连，飞也似的跑了过去，

en: The old umbrella man's words of praise at once changed into words of prayer and drifted through the air.
u.src: 伞翁的歌颂之词顿时改为祈祷之词，在空中飘荡。

en: Everyone present followed along and cried out in one voice, Lord, please protect him.
u.src: 在场的所有人跟随者齐声高呼：“主啊，求您保佑！”
边祈祷边流泪。

en: Thus the holy son of the Virgin Mary, our Lord Jesus Christ, listened with a compassionate heart to the cries of the people.
u.src: 就这样，圣母玛利亚的圣子，我主耶稣基督，以感同身受的心，倾听到了众人的呼吁，

en: Then they saw Loren, his whole body scorched, being carried in Simeon's arms, rescued and brought back from the fire.
u.src: 只见全身被烧焦的罗连，正被西美昂双臂抱着，从火场中的得救而归了。

en: In a single evening, such a tremendous change had taken place,
u.src: 一夕之间，发生如此巨变，

en: when Lorenzo's life was hanging by a thread, the believers joined forces and carried him to the front of the church,
u.src: 在罗连命悬一线的时候，教众合力将他送至教堂前，

en: as he lay quietly on the bed, the umbrella woman, holding an infant in her arms with eyes full of tears,
u.src: 他安静的躺在床上的时候，手上抱着幼儿满目含泪的伞女，

en: suddenly appeared in the doorway and knelt at the priest's feet,
u.src: 突然出现在门中跪在神甫脚下，

en: and, under everyone's gaze, unexpectedly began to confess,
u.src: 在众目睽睽之下，竟然意外的开始忏悔，

en: She cried out, "This child is not Lorenzo's flesh and blood,
u.src: 她大声说：“这个孩子不是罗连的骨头，

en: but was born from my affair with a neighboring heathen."
u.src: 而是我与邻人异教徒私通所生。”

en: Her voice rang with righteous resolve, and her tearless eyes shone with a steadfast gaze,
u.src: 声音大义凛然，没有眼泪的眼睛透着坚定的目光，

en: which proved that her confession was no lie.
u.src: 正对证了她的忏悔并非虚言。

en: Hearing these words, the believers present were so shocked that they held their breath,
u.src: 听了这话，在场的教众无比瞿然屏息，

en: and for a moment forgot the great fire filling the sky before them.
u.src: 顿时忘了眼前的满天大火。

en: The umbrella woman stopped crying and went on speaking: "
u.src: 伞女停止哭泣，继续说道：“

en: I secretly loved Luo Lian, but his heart was utterly steadfast, and he sternly rejected me,
u.src: 我私下暗恋罗连，奈何他的心无比坚笃，凛然拒绝了我，

en: I harbored resentment, so I falsely accused him by saying that the child in my womb was Luo Lian's, using that to take revenge on him.
u.src: 我心存怨恨，于是诬陷说我腹中之子乃是罗连的骨头，以此来报复他。

en: Luo Lian was noble in character, yet he did not defend himself, nor did he resent me,
u.src: 罗连品德高尚，竟然不为自己声辩，也不怨恨我，

en: Even after I committed such a grave wrong, today he still disregarded his own safety, braved the fires of hell, and saved my child's life,
u.src: 我犯了这么打错，今天他还不顾安危，冒着地狱之火，救我儿的性命，

en: His merciful heart is boundless; truly, he is Jesus born again.
u.src: 他的慈悲之心广博，真乃耶稣再生啊。

en: I have committed such a terrible sin that even if my flesh were torn to shreds by demon claws and I died, I would accept it willingly."
u.src: 我犯了如此大罪，即使是肌肉寸裂于魔爪而死，也心甘情愿。”

en: When the umbrella woman finished her confession, she again fell to the ground and kept sobbing bitterly.
u.src: 伞女忏悔完毕，有伏在地上痛哭不止。

en: At that moment, from among the many believers present, someone shouted, “Martyrdom!”
u.src: 这个时候，在场的众教众之中，有人大喊：“殉教！”

en: Cries of “Martyrdom!” rose one after another, surging like stormy waves.
u.src: “殉教！”声此起彼伏，入波涛汹涌。

en: Lorenzo had pitied the condemned man, and though he himself had fallen into beggary, he still offered no defense for himself,
u.src: 罗连同情罪人，虽然自己沦为乞丐，也不为自己辩解，

en: so that even the priest who was like a father to him and Simeon who was like a brother,
u.src: 即使是如父亲般的神甫和如兄弟般的西美昂，

en: failed to recognize his noble virtue and almost let such a steadfast martyr slip away.
u.src: 都未能识出他高尚的品德，差点错失一个如此坚定的殉教士。

ja: き、かすかにうなずいた。
en: When Loren heard the umbrella woman's confession, he gave a slight nod; by then the skin and hair all over his body had been burned and charred, his limbs could no longer move, and he could only listen in silence.
u.src: 罗连听到伞女的忏悔，微微额首，这时他全身肌肤头发已经焦毁，四肢无法动弹，默然不语，只能听着。

en: The umbrella old man felt as if his very organs would split apart, so he ran with Simeon to Loren's side, hoping they might save him.
u.src: 伞翁如五脏欲裂，于是和西美昂一起跑到罗连的旁边希望能够救助他。

en: Loren was gasping for breath; at the edge of death, his eyes shone as brightly as they always had, and he looked up at the sky.
u.src: 罗连气喘吁吁，弥留之际，如平日一样眼神熠熠生辉，仰望天空。

en: The priest stood with his back to the gate, his white cloth fluttering in the night wind.
u.src: 神甫背门而立，白巾在夜风中飘扬。

en: After hearing the umbrella woman's confession, the priest solemnly declared:
u.src: 听完伞女的忏悔，神甫肃然宣布：

en: Those who sincerely repent will surely be blessed,
u.src: “真心悔改的人必有福报，

en: Rather than wait for others to punish you, engrave the commandments of God deep in your heart,
u.src: 与其等待别人惩罚你，不如深刻铭记天主的戒律，

en: and quietly await the Last Judgment.
u.src: 静待末日审判。

en: Luolian's deeds throughout his life showed that he had deeply understood Christ's will,
u.src: 罗连生平行事，便是深刻体会了基督的意志，

en: among the believers here, he was a rare person of noble virtue.
u.src: 在本地的教众里面，是罕见德行高尚的人。

en: He, with the spirit of a young boy..."
u.src: 他以少男之神……”

en: When the priest had spoken this far, he suddenly fell silent,
u.src: 神甫讲到这里，突然停口，

en: as if he had seen a flash of holy light, and stared at Luolian lying there,
u.src: 似乎见到圣光闪现，熟视罗连横陈之姿，

en: then suddenly turned pale with shock, his face solemn and his hands trembling slightly,
u.src: 突然大惊失色，神色庄重，双手微颤，

ja: たりにしたようだった。
en: as though he had witnessed a miracle.
u.src: 好似见到了奇迹一般。

en: Hot tears burst from his wrinkled face.
u.src: 布满皱纹的脸上，热泪夺眶而出。

en: At that moment, Simeon and the umbrella old man
u.src: 这个时候，西美昂和伞翁，

en: also noticed the beautiful youth lying quietly before St. Luke's Church in the firelight,
u.src: 也注意到在火光映照下静静躺在圣鲁卡教堂前的美少年，

en: from within the scorched and torn bodice, a maiden's breasts were faintly visible,
u.src: 在烧焦残破的胸衣里，微微露出了少女的双乳，
莹然如玉。

en: Even her fire-scorched, jade-like face could not hide her delicate beauty.
u.src: 而被煅的玉容，也不能掩盖她娇美的身姿。

en: "Ah, Luolian is a girl! Luolian is a girl!"
u.src: “啊，罗连是女孩！罗连是女孩！”

en: The believers standing around with their backs to the fireground all turned blank and pale,
u.src: 背靠火场站在周围的教众，都木然失色，

en: for Luolian, who had been expelled from Luke's church for breaking the vow of chastity,
u.src: 因为破色戒而被被逐鲁卡堂的罗连，

en: was in fact the same sex as the umbrella woman, a local girl with beautiful, glistening eyes.
u.src: 竟与伞女同性，是一个美目盈盈之本地少女。

en: In that instant, everyone was filled with solemn reverence, as though they heard the Lord's sacred voice coming from far away through a starless dark night.
u.src: 瞬间，众人都肃然起敬，好似听到天主玉青，从没有星空的暗夜远远的传来。

en: Then the believers before Saint Luke's church, like ears of wheat swept down by the wind, all bowed their heads and knelt around Lorenzo, and the only sound they could hear was the towering blaze roaring through the air.
u.src: 于是圣鲁卡堂前的教众如风靡麦穗，都低头环跪罗连身侧，耳边所能听见的只有万丈烈焰在空中呼啸。

en: After that, not only the umbrella woman but also Simeon, who was as close as a brother, stood in silence with both arms raised, solemnly listening to the priest's prayer and calling Lorenzo's name aloud.
u.src: 之后，不光是伞女，亲如兄弟的西美昂，也都在静默中高举双腕，肃然聆听神甫的祈祷，大声呼唤罗连的名字。

en: The beautiful local girl, smiling as she gazed up at the sky, suddenly passed away.
u.src: 本地美少女，面带微笑，仰望天空，溘然长逝。

ja: られているのはこれだけで、
en: This is all that is known about the life of this young woman; nothing else has been heard, yet this matter alone is already deeply astonishing.
u.src: 这个少女的生平，所知道的就这些了，其他的事情还未听说，然而这件事已经很震撼了。

ja: することはできなかった。
en: While she was alive, she possessed supreme dignity, and no one could rival her.
u.src: 她活着的时候无上尊严，没有谁可以和她匹敌。

en: The journey through this world enters a vast night sea; when a single wave rises, it may touch the bright light of the new moon, but those who live carelessly have no chance to feel the true meaning of life.
u.src: 世间旅途入茫茫夜海，一波崛起，可以和新月的明光接触，苟然之人，没有机会感受到生命真正的意义。

en: Therefore, to know what happened at the end of Loren's life is enough to understand Loren's whole life.
u.src: 因此，了解罗连生命最后发生的事，也足以了解罗连的一生了！
